note: Replaces the previous model trained on the repo's 42-row Testing.csv, which recorded 0.0 test accuracy (unstratified split on too few rows for the class count). This dataset is large enough for a real stratified split and 5-fold cross-validation. CAVEAT: this public dataset gives every disease a fixed, non-overlapping symptom signature with no noise, so accuracy near 100% here reflects that the dataset is perfectly separable, not that real-world ambiguous/overlapping symptom presentations are solved. Treat this model's confidence as dataset-clean-case performance, not clinical validation.
